meta_description:
bruisedpassports on October 7, 2026: "This isn’t about influence anymore.It’s about impact 😇✨

Spoke at Entrepreneur Summit 2026 this week about the importance of reinventing constantly alongside some of the most brilliant founders in the country, and left the room feeling genuinely excited about what lies ahead.

We spoke about what happens when years of lived experience, understanding people and spotting travel trends translate into ideas that can actually move the needle-for brands, platforms and travellers alike 🌍😇

As we continue building the Bruised Passports App, moments like these feel particularly full circle. From engineer → to creator → to Key Opinion Leader → to building a technology product of our own ⭕️ 

The medium is pivoting. The ambition has grown. But the curiosity that started it all remains exactly the same. Same curiosity. Sharper lens. Bigger vision. 
So excited for what lies ahead 🤞🌍

#bruisedpassports #entrepreneurship #startup".
